title: Tech Note: Multi-Splash Screen
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This is a classic-forms UI recipe (picture library, variable objects, custom splash form) that still works today in 4D but is a manual DIY pattern; nothing about it has been deprecated, though it predates and is unrelated to newer Qodly-based UI approaches.
related_updates: Picture Library, On Startup, and JSON-based settings persistence are all still fully current 4D techniques with no replacement needed
No built-in multi-splash-screen feature has since been added to 4D, so this DIY approach remains the way to achieve this effect
